one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used readInt32LE (signed) instead of readUInt32LE (unsigned) to extract 4-byte memory values from ELF segments, producing incorrect negative values for words with high bit set, and its verification only checked count and address range rather than value correctness against the expected unsigned output.
t_commit_evidence: In step 9, the agent runs the script for the first time and outputs out.json, committing to the incorrect signed-integer output; the agent never changes the read function from Int32 to UInt32 in any subsequent edit.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked awareness that ELF memory extraction tasks typically require unsigned 32-bit integer representation; it defaulted to signed reads (readInt32LE) without considering that values with the high bit set would be misrepresented as negative numbers compared to the reference unsigned values.
